changelog: New Terminal radar manager with instant GPS routing and 10m on-site dismantle check, 80% screen tablet UI, simplified multi-lane form and DrawSpotLight native fix.
Multi-lane speed trap placement across highways, real FOV cone detection (60-360 degrees), 200ms reactive radar server loop, and seamless quick menu navigation.
Fixed speed camera form scrolling: added vertical scrolling with sleek scrollbar and expanded modal max height so all fields and buttons are accessible on any resolution.

Speed camera overhaul: streamed 3D physical props, interactive laser fan placement with live model cycling, 3D double xenon flash with world audio, speed limit presets, and target dismantling/reconfiguration.
Speed camera creator with resizable zones, fines sent as invoices, timed searches, sized traffic zones and a brand new MDT. Requires acn_bridge 2.12.0.
Fixed placement missing clicks, one press now places exactly one item.
Police menu opens on hover, new deployment menu with series placement from 1 to 10 items or continuous.
Fixed the quick menu freezing when acn_bridge was not up to date.
Quick menu driven by the arrow keys while moving, Alt shows a cursor. Requires acn_bridge 2.11.0.
Searches open the real inventory, only when the person is cuffed, down or has their hands up.
New hands up with a smooth animation and walking handcuffs by default.
Clock in on the duty NPC, new quick list menu. Requires acn_bridge 2.10.0.
The police menu now lives in the target, with nested menus on vehicles and anywhere.
Radial menu is optional with no default key.
New design and icons on every screen. Requires acn_bridge 2.9.0.
First release of the rebuilt police job: duty, handcuffs, escort, searches, citations, fleet, armory, uniforms, impound, BOLO and officer GPS.
Server-read speed cameras, portable cameras, patrol radar and traffic control with spike strips, road zones and stop orders.
Every setting can be changed in game with /conf_acn_policejobV2. Requires acn_bridge 2.8.1.
